method DivMod1(a: int, b: int) returns (q: int, r: int)
requires b > -1 && a >= 0
ensures a == b*q + r && 0 <= r < b
{

		r := a;

So the fix is to change `requires b > -1 && a >= 0` to `requires b > 0 && a >= 0`.
